additional_info.body:
Dear Markus,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Oulu
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
JKAD6V
Problem Description
: Failure during 5.0.21 update and offline
Troubleshooting
:
Thank you for raising the issue. However, I see that the charger on SCB does not show a successful firmware update, it still reflects the last update. Additionally, in our asset records, there is already an open case for this charger related to a DC contactor fault and dispenser self-test failure.
Please let us know when you plan to go on-site for troubleshooting regarding ticket ID0367733. Also, can you confirm if we can merge this ticket with the existing one? When you go on-site, please ensure to bring a spare router, an extra SIM card, and Ethernet cables, along with the troubleshooting items shared in the previous ticket.
Reference Ticket :
https://isp.crm4.dynamics.com/main.aspx?appid=582042be-d464-ed11-9562-000d3ab780dd&pagetype=entityrecord&etn=incident&id=d42da1ee-bb06-4d02-882a-75a1f51cd848
For future reference, your ticket number is
0382862
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
